title: Billet Designator-Unrestricted Information Officer (I) (LtCol to Capt) EMOS, DC I
raw_text:
12. MOS 8017, Billet Designator-Unrestricted Information Officer (I) (LtCol
to Capt) EMOS, DC I

    a. Summary. This MOS will be used in the T/O to designate a billet to
which an unrestricted officer with an information related PMOS may be
assigned but will not be assigned to an individual.

    b. Prerequisites. Must possess PMOSs 0202, Intelligence Officer, 0602,
Communications Officer, 1702, Cyberspace Warfare Officer, 1706, Maritime
Space Officer, 1707, Influence Officer, or 4502, Communications Strategy and
Operations Officer. Officers with FMOS/EMOSs 1781, Basic Information
Planner, 1730, Civil Affairs Officer, 0550, Advanced Information Operations
Planner, or 1704, Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO) Planner are also
eligible.

       c.   Requirements.     None.

       d.   Duties.   None.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Command and Control Center Officers 55-1015.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.
